I wanted to share my most recent bitcoin use here. I am currently in the process of ordering from a new distributor who happens to be in Europe. When placing my order wire transfer was the only payment option included on the invoice. I asked if they would be willing to accept bitcoin and pointed out a payment processor that served their country. They agreed but said it would take time to verify their account. So I said I would call my bank and see if it was worth while to place my first order via wire. For me to send about $700 the charge would be $40 + a 5% exchange fee, and would take 1-5 days. So possibly just as long as waiting for the seller to get bitcoin processing setup. It actually costs almost as much to send the money as the shipping on actual physical products.

If I pay 10% less by using bitcoin that's a significant competitive advantage over other companies reselling the same products. I also means I am more likely to purchase more from this company so I make more money per sale, and they make more sales. Win win.

Thank you bitcoin!

I'm talking about those games you'll never forget, those games that for some reason (childhood, epic moment) will always stay in your heart.
Civ V, Minecraft, KOTOR, Bastion, The Banner Saga, Half-Life 2.
KOTOR is one of the best gaming experiences. Even though it's old and a little clunky at this point, it's still so immersive.

Mine are:

Sonic's Adventure (Director's Cut): this game is just perfect. Amazing graphics (for a 2005(?) game), loads of easter eggs, beautiful environments, catchy music and all. Unfortunately, I don't know how to install it on my new PC :( I guess it's a compatibility problem. I was 4-6 when I started playing.

Super Meat Boy: damn, this game's hard. But I 100%'d it!! I love how it's hard, fast paced and dynamic. +1 for being 2D. Beautiful music. I have the t-shirt signed by the developers!

PacMan World 2: this one's like the sonic one: good graphics and music and all. The fact that it's one of my first games ever brings a tear on my eye. As I'm typing the feels are... feeling
The Mass Effect series is one of my favorite. I've got the same complaints about ME3 as everyone. Also, please don't fuck up Andromeda, Bioware.

I spend half of my time playing video games and I hate when I'm asked this question, it's hard to decide. I'd have to say favorites of all time include Quake TF, TF2, Contra, Portal 1 and 2, The Mario and Zelda 2d games, it's so hard to think of all the masterpieces that have been released over the past 30 years

Fallout 3, Super Smash bros melee, and tLoZ Minish Cap.

Fallout 3 was the only game i had on ps3 for a really, really long time and for while it was kinda the only game I needed. There was always something new to discover that I hadn't seen before so I could always go back to it and I still do sometimes. And all the dlc just added more.

I've always played melee with my family. My cousins and I would set up tournaments and shit so I have a lot of great memories from those. They'd actually get kind serious sometimes too. It's also probably the only fighting game I'm not complete ass at. I love that it can be so easy to pick up but there's still a crazy amount of depth to it if you want to take the time to figure that stuff out.

Even though it seems like no one talks about minish cap it was the first zelda game I beat. I'd played the older ones but never finished them so minish cap will always be special to me. Plus the art I really loved the art style and the whole shrinking and getting to explore the world from a different perspective.
